product_overview: DevTracker is a frontend-only project management app for software teams. It helps users manage projects, plannings, tasks, kanban workflow, calendar views, users/roles, and theme preferences with data stored locally in the browser.
core_goals: Log in and access protected workspace areas
View project and task progress from a central dashboard
Manage projects, plannings, tasks, and kanban workflow
Switch between light and dark themes

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows users to sign in with email and password to access the protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid email credentials -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See error message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Shows an overview of task progress, project status, pipeline progress, and upcoming planning deadlines.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See general progress metrics and project status summaries -> Open board link -> See kanban board

features.name: Kanban Board
features.description: Lets users manage workflow columns and move tasks across the pipeline.
user_flows: Navigate to /tablero -> See default workflow columns and tasks -> Drag a task to another column -> See the task appear in the new column
Navigate to /tablero -> See workflow columns -> Drag a column to reorder -> See the columns change order
Navigate to /tablero -> Open columns management -> Create a new column -> See the column added to the board
Navigate to /tablero -> Open columns management -> Delete a column -> Confirm the deletion -> See the column removed from the board
Navigate to /tablero -> Select a task -> See task detail

features.name: Projects
features.description: Allows users to view, create, edit, and delete projects.
user_flows: Navigate to /proyectos -> See project cards -> Create a new project -> Save the project -> See the project added to the list
Navigate to /proyectos -> See project cards -> Choose a project to edit -> Update project information -> Save the project -> See the updated project card
Navigate to /proyectos -> See project cards -> Delete a project -> Confirm the deletion -> See the project removed from the list

features.name: Planning
features.description: Allows users to manage plannings, including planning details, estimates, and planning tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /planning -> See planning list -> Create a new planning -> Save the planning -> See the planning added to the list
Navigate to /planning -> See planning list -> Choose a planning to edit -> Update planning information -> Save the planning -> See the updated planning in the list
Navigate to /planning -> See planning list -> Delete a planning -> Confirm the deletion -> See the planning removed from the list
Navigate to /planning -> Open planning detail -> See planning information and associated tasks
Navigate to /planning -> Open planning tasks management -> Mark a planning task as completed -> See the task completion status change

features.name: Tasks
features.description: Allows users to create, view, and edit individual tasks.
user_flows: Navigate to /tarea/nueva -> Fill in task details -> Save the task -> See the new task detail
Navigate to /tarea/:id -> See task detail -> Edit the task -> Save changes -> See the updated task detail

features.name: Calendar
features.description: Provides a calendar view for dates and activities.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendario -> See the calendar view

features.name: User Administration
features.description: Allows administrators to view, create, edit, delete users, and change user roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /usuarios -> See user list -> Create a new user -> Save the user -> See the user added to the list
Navigate to /usuarios -> See user list -> Edit a user -> Save changes -> See the updated user information
Navigate to /usuarios -> See user list -> Change a user role -> See the role update reflected in the list
Navigate to /usuarios -> See user list -> Delete a user -> Confirm the deletion -> See the user removed from the list

features.name: Dark Mode
features.description: Lets users toggle between light and dark themes with the preference saved for future visits.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme -> See the interface switch between light and dark mode
